Ice Boat Express

  1. Steer through the flag gates. Anticipate the bends and bring the cargo to Snowbell Village.
  2. DRAG LEFT / RIGHT. A / D also steer.
  3. Points, progress and the next target stay visible. END saves a result. Retry starts fresh.
Credits & sources
